services.name: View Our Tumbling Programs
services.desc: Does your child love to tumble, but is not as interested in the vault, uneven bars, or balance beam? Then TUMBLING is for them! In Beginning Tumbling boys and girls the fundamentals of Tumbling. This class provides a solid foundation for more difficult skills to be learned as students gain strength, coordination, and confidence. Advanced Beginner is the next step for boys and girls, building on the fundamental level of floor exercise skills (tumbling) they’ve acquired in Beginner Tumbling. Our emphasis is not on who’s the fastest, the strongest or the best, but on the adventure of growth and learning. Students focus on more advanced tumbling skills at this level, including back handsprings,

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Our summer camps are packed with themed gymnastics and ninja fun! Campers will enjoy structured instruction as they rotate through exciting courses, along with active group games that make great use of our gym equipment. Most of the camp takes place in the gym, with the 3-hour session thoughtfully broken into smaller segments to keep kids engaged and energized. Campers will enjoy snack breaks, craft time, and a short outdoor activity (weather permitting) as part of their day. Staying hydrated is important during camp.
